requirements.description: Offline read-only preflight passes on the reference Windows machine.
Runtime and build dependencies are exactly pinned and match the lock evidence.
Offline wheel build, contents, entry points, and import smoke pass.
Documented clean-machine install and first-run procedure passes without undeclared dependencies.
PostgreSQL, artifact store, API health, and worker job-store readiness all pass.
A database and artifact backup is restored and integrity-checked.
Schema migration and archived v1/v2 replay evidence passes.
The immutable 300-prompt supported benchmark meets all acceptance thresholds.
All 100 unsupported/adversarial cases return typed failures without fabricated success.
Three identical replays agree on task outcome and required numerical tolerances.
Five ten-second candidates complete simulation and evidence generation within 90 seconds p95, excluding VLM.
Human calibration meets kappa, order-consistency, and critical false-accept thresholds.
Held-out RAG-on improvement has a positive 95% confidence interval and retrieval quality passes.
Dataset namespace, research-only, attribution, and Deaf expert review obligations are audited.
Backup, rollback, degraded-mode, and incident-response runbook is exercised by an operator.
